answer: Each epoch the network auctions a few entry slots, burning the winning bid. Honest agents pay once and keep their slot. A sybil attacker wanting N identities must win N auctions: at 40 POA a slot, 100 fakes cost 4,000 POA against 30 POA earned per identity per epoch, so the attack stays underwater for a long horizon. The auction is a prism splitting entrants by willingness to pay, and its shale-hard floor exposes mass fabrication up front.
